opencode-ahp `0.1.8` — AHP 1.0.0 host for opencode v2, published to npm.

**Install** ([README — Install](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/blob/main/README.md#install)):

```bash
opencode plugin add opencode-ahp
```

or pin this build: `opencode plugin add opencode-ahp@0.1.8`

- [d723401](https://github.com/mattzink/opencode-ahp/commit/d7234014521bffa022253009afef90813fe22c51) Remove location keep-alive support (Matt Zinkevicius)
